intent.summary: Milestone lifecycle mechanics and ceremony on the hierarchical model (B-double-prime): project.json is the Lv4 parent container — phase entries gain additive task_ref and completed_at snapshot fields written at mark-done/archive time, resume composes parent plus resident child state (no dedicated parent state file, state.json schema untouched, no levelless shell ever created); implement milestone close-with-parked, fix the P0 phase insertion order, close the shipped v1.0.0-dev milestone with parked P2/P3 carried over, open the publicize milestone, and re-home P2/P3 onto it unchanged (their execution stays with the phases themselves, after P23).

decisions.title: Phase snapshots: task_ref = archive basename at archive time; mark-done stamps completed_at only
decisions.rationale: Each done-with-work phase has exactly one archive dir; basename unique, self-locating; null task_ref = close-out that never ran; tid-only would force glob re-derivation

observable_truths.description: P0 at index 0 and names in monotonic order in phase list
after archive of a phase task, its project.json entry carries task_ref = archive basename and completed_at ISO stamp

milestone close --carry-parked --yes leaves parked phases + parked-owned rows + pending phase entries present in project.json, byte-equal to the preclose backup; snapshots exist as dated view .md files + preclose.json and in the closing milestone-record/
milestone open publicize stamps milestone {name, opened_at}; the NEXT archived task slug prefix reads publicize; in the closed-not-reopened gap slugs carry no version prefix
with state.json absent and the Lv4 marker present, gos resume prints NO ACTIVE TASK + milestone identity + phase queue + clone warning (exit 0)
gos init --project in a fresh repo creates project.json, lv4.json marker, and views but no state.json; init --project on a repo with Lv4 trace refuses without --fresh
gos phase mark-done on a never-claimed phase stamps completed_at and leaves task_ref null
post-close project.json: decisions array empty or milestone-owned only, done-owned requirement rows = 0, dropped/ghost rows counted in the report, last_archived_phase null
gos milestone open evil/../x and backtick names die with a sanitization contract error; a tainted name never reaches a path, slug, or echo line
legacy wrapper state (project=true, no phase_name) triggers the retirement prompt; after retirement, stateless resume takes over
